title: VR Aquarium -雅-
description:
You can spend relaxing time with goldfish in VR space.



In VR space you can do the following operations.

· You can touch goldfish

· You can call goldfish

· You can take pictures and Gif movie.

· You can change the background.

· You can change BGM



The types of goldfish are below

・Wakin(和金)

・Comet(コメット)

・Ryukin(琉金)

・Demekin(出目金)

・Rantyu(らんちゅう)



The type of background is below

・BubbleDome

・Sakura

・Fireworks



Future Update

· Increase the kind of goldfish

· Adjust the appearance of goldfish

· Add the function to edit Aquarium

· Plans to fix the problem
description_short: You can spend relaxing time with goldfish in VR space.
